'''Jeremay Sann'tiago''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] allied with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3638 BBY]], he was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]] as part of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial forces]] there.
